item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and trace the assertions for any faulty assumptions or edge cases.

This module provides small order helpers: calculate item totals, apply percentage discount codes, compute an “average” price, and format an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the last iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined), causing `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'price')`. It should use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` calculates total line-item cost divided by the number of item records. That is an average line subtotal, not average unit price when quantities vary. For unit-price average, divide by total quantity instead.
- `averageItemPrice([])` would yield `NaN` (once `calcTotal` is fixed), so empty orders need an explicit defined behavior.
